Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) shows a distinct, rounded mass with central hyperdensity (likely embolic material/coils) located in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, corresponding to the right middle lobe. This lateral position and size are consistent with causing mild displacement or compression of adjacent structures like the right lower lobe bronchus, distinguishing it from medial or upper/lower lobe locations.
